index.html.title: HomeCircle: free addiction recovery support in Australia
index.html.description: Find AA/NA meetings, try breathing exercises when cravings hit, count your days and reach helplines. Free, no account needed. Support, not medical care.

help.html.title: Helplines and gambling help in Australia – HomeCircle
help.html.description: Call 000 in an emergency. Lifeline 13 11 14, Beyond Blue, alcohol and drug lines, gambling help and family support, all in one place.

meetings.html.title: Find AA/NA meetings near you – HomeCircle
meetings.html.description: Search AA and NA meetings in Australia by suburb, postcode or day. No sign-in needed. HomeCircle isn't affiliated with AA or NA.

events.html.title: Recovery events in Australia – HomeCircle
events.html.description: Upcoming AA and NA events in Australia, linked from their own official pages. HomeCircle isn't affiliated with AA or NA.

support.html.title: Support and FAQs – HomeCircle
support.html.description: How to contact HomeCircle, answers to common questions, and where to get help right now. Support, not medical care.

your-circle.html.title: Sober day counter and journal – HomeCircle
your-circle.html.description: An optional day counter and private journal that stay only in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

twelve-steps.html.title: The 12 Steps in plain language – HomeCircle
twelve-steps.html.description: Plain-language notes on the 12 Steps, with a link to AA's own wording. HomeCircle isn't affiliated with AA or NA. Support, not medical care.

library.html.title: Recovery Library – HomeCircle
library.html.description: Short guides for recovery: breathing and grounding tools, urge surfing, quit-drinking tips and links to official recovery resources in Australia.

meditations.html.title: Breathing exercises and short meditations – HomeCircle
meditations.html.description: Animated box, 4-7-8 and slow out-breath guides to try when cravings hit, plus short meditations. Free, and you can stop any time.

families/index.html.title: For families, partners and friends – HomeCircle
families/index.html.description: Help for people who care about someone with an alcohol, drug or gambling problem in Australia. Support, not medical care.

families/child.html.title: My child is drinking or using drugs, how can I help? – HomeCircle
families/child.html.description: For parents worried about a son or daughter's drinking or drug use: what to say, what to watch for and where to get support in Australia.

families/family.html.title: My parent or family member is addicted, what can I do? – HomeCircle
families/family.html.description: When a mum, dad, brother, sister or other relative has a drinking or drug problem: what helps, and where to get support in Australia.

families/friend.html.title: My friend has a drug or alcohol problem, how can I help? – HomeCircle
families/friend.html.description: How to support a friend who drinks or uses drugs too much, without carrying it all yourself. Where to get help in Australia.

families/partner.html.title: My partner is addicted, what can I do? – HomeCircle
families/partner.html.description: When your partner drinks, uses drugs or gambles: what to say, warning signs, and where you can both get support in Australia.

families/kids.html.title: For kids and teens – HomeCircle
families/kids.html.description: A HomeCircle page for kids and teens whose parent drinks or uses drugs: it's not your fault, and who to talk to.

families/overdose.html.title: What to do in an overdose – HomeCircle
families/overdose.html.description: Signs of an overdose and what to do: call 000, recovery position, CPR and naloxone, from Australian first aid sources. Support, not medical care.

families/safety.html.title: Family violence help – HomeCircle
families/safety.html.description: 1800RESPECT, every state and territory domestic violence line, and the Men's Referral Service, for families affected by addiction and violence.

families/withdrawal.html.title: Supporting someone through withdrawal – HomeCircle
families/withdrawal.html.description: Warning signs, when to call 000, and who to call for advice in Australia when someone you love is in withdrawal. Support, not medical care.

library/alcoholics-anonymous.html.title: Alcoholics Anonymous – HomeCircle
library/alcoholics-anonymous.html.description: Where to find AA Australia's own pages and meetings. HomeCircle doesn't host AA literature and isn't affiliated with AA or NA.

library/narcotics-anonymous.html.title: Narcotics Anonymous – HomeCircle
library/narcotics-anonymous.html.description: Where to find NA Australia's own pages and meetings. HomeCircle doesn't host NA literature and isn't affiliated with AA or NA.

library/gambling-support.html.title: Gambling help – HomeCircle
library/gambling-support.html.description: Gambling Help Online and 1800 858 858, plus a link to Gamblers Anonymous's own site. HomeCircle isn't affiliated with Gamblers Anonymous.

library/pornography-addiction-support.ht.title: Pornography addiction support – HomeCircle
library/pornography-addiction-support.ht.description: Lifeline can talk now on 13 11 14. Links to an official support group's own site, which HomeCircle isn't affiliated with. Support, not medical care.

library/recovery-books.html.title: Recovery books and audio – HomeCircle
library/recovery-books.html.description: Links to free recovery reading and audio on official recovery sites. Links only. HomeCircle isn't affiliated with AA or NA.

library/24-hour-plan.html.title: 24-hour plan – HomeCircle
library/24-hour-plan.html.description: Plan the next day, not the whole year. A simple guide for getting through today without a drink. Support, not medical care.

library/4-7-8-breathing.html.title: 4-7-8 breathing – HomeCircle
library/4-7-8-breathing.html.description: Breathe in for 4, hold for 7, out for 8. A longer out-breath to try when cravings hit.

library/box-breathing.html.title: Box breathing – HomeCircle
library/box-breathing.html.description: A steady 4-4-4-4 count: in, hold, out, hold. Something to try when cravings hit. Stop whenever you want.

library/slow-out-breath.html.title: Slow out-breath – HomeCircle
library/slow-out-breath.html.description: Breathe in for 4 and out for 6, with no hold. The gentlest of the three breathing guides.

library/breathing-anchor.html.title: Breathing anchor – HomeCircle
library/breathing-anchor.html.description: Five easy out-breaths with your eyes open and the room still in view. Support, not medical care.

library/body-scan.html.title: Body scan – HomeCircle
library/body-scan.html.description: An optional short walk of attention from your feet upward. Support, not medical care.

library/grounding-5-4-3-2-1.html.title: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding – HomeCircle
library/grounding-5-4-3-2-1.html.description: Eyes open. Notice five things you see, then what you feel, hear, smell and taste. Support, not medical care.

library/halt.html.title: HALT: hungry, angry, lonely, tired – HomeCircle
library/halt.html.description: A quick pause to check if you're hungry, angry, lonely or tired. A self check-in, not a medical check. Support, not medical care.

library/mindful-eating.html.title: Mindful eating – HomeCircle
library/mindful-eating.html.description: Slow down one snack or meal and notice it with your senses. Support, not medical care.

library/mindful-walking.html.title: Mindful walking – HomeCircle
library/mindful-walking.html.description: A slow walk where you notice your feet, your breath and what's around you. Support, not medical care.

library/one-thing-focus.html.title: One-thing focus – HomeCircle
library/one-thing-focus.html.description: Ten minutes on one ordinary task, to give your mind somewhere to rest. Support, not medical care.

library/urge-surfing.html.title: Urge surfing guide – HomeCircle
library/urge-surfing.html.description: Watch an urge rise and fall without acting on it. A short guide to try when cravings hit. Support, not medical care.

library/urge-surfing-meditation.html.title: Urge surfing meditation – HomeCircle
library/urge-surfing-meditation.html.description: A short guided sit with the wave of an urge, until it passes. Support, not medical care.

library/stress-and-anxiety.html.title: Stress and anxiety – HomeCircle
library/stress-and-anxiety.html.description: What stress does in the body, and three small things to try when it builds. Support, not medical care.

library/alcohol-and-the-body.html.title: Alcohol and the body – HomeCircle
library/alcohol-and-the-body.html.description: Rough stages people describe after they stop drinking. General notes, not a diagnosis. Support, not medical care.

library/cannabis-and-the-body.html.title: Cannabis and the body – HomeCircle
library/cannabis-and-the-body.html.description: Sleep, appetite and irritability after stopping cannabis. General notes, not a verdict. Support, not medical care.

library/opioids-and-the-body.html.title: Opioids and the body – HomeCircle
library/opioids-and-the-body.html.description: Opioid withdrawal can feel like a severe flu. Get medical advice before you stop. Support, not medical care.

library/stimulants-and-the-body.html.title: Stimulants and the body – HomeCircle
library/stimulants-and-the-body.html.description: The crash, sleep and mood after stopping stimulants. General notes only. Support, not medical care.

library/body-and-recovery-stages.html.title: Body and recovery stages – HomeCircle
library/body-and-recovery-stages.html.description: What many people notice in the first days, weeks and months of recovery. General notes, not a diagnosis. Support, not medical care.
